method: Existing corrected illustration aircraft-only alpha, registered through original background; obsolete aircraft and shadow removed using local original graypad fit and concealed H-leg continuation; soft body and wheel contactshadow added. No generated background/pad transfer.

visualReview.findings: No generated-pad angular seams; obsolete topcenter rotor shadow removed. Orange Mi-8 type fuselage, black engine and tailboom, white-orange bands, white body graphic, circular windows and five main blades. No logo/name/flag/registration/text. Source vehicles, people, buildings, water, visible pad edges, cones and windsock preserved.
visualReview.limitations: Original source-resolution composite; no native-upscale claim. Shared alpha is manually traced. Hidden pad region reconstructed locally; stakeholder approval and runtime integration remain separate.
